title: fix(service-analytics): a windowed dataset answer reports its window in drillRanges
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XNhm8vEAcYhLXyH8smEnuHt)_

Fixes #27074

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：报表选了时间段（`selection.timeDimensions[].dateRange`，如“本季度”）后，数据集查询的回答在已有的 `drillRanges` 里带上这个时间段的边界：没按该日期分组时每行多一条 `{ field, gte, lt }`；按同一字段分桶时，首尾两个桶的范围收窄到时间段以内。没有新增键。
- **为什么改**：报表按阶段分组、选“本季度”后，点阶段下钻，列表里出现所有季度的商机，柱子上的数和列表对不上；`last_30_days` 的首尾月份下钻也会列出整月。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只改回答里的下钻元数据，不改查询本身过滤什么；边界直接复用查询自己的解析（预设按请求时区、显式区间原样、共享的整日规则、引擎的存储形式），不在浏览器或服务端另写一套。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/services/service-analytics/src/drill-window.ts`；`analytics-service.ts` 的 `drillRanges` 块（窗口与桶按字段合并）；`src/__tests__/dataset-drill-window.test.ts` 的真实引擎用例。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/__tests__/dataset-drill-window.test.ts`，预期 21/21 通过；在 `main` 上同一文件 18 条失败。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

A dataset query whose selection carries `timeDimensions[].dateRange` now reports that window in the answer's existing `drillRanges`, so a drill list filters by exactly the bounds the query filtered by. Nothing under `ui/`, and nothing the query filters changes.

- **An ungrouped windowed dimension** (a report grouped by `stage`, windowed on `close_date`) gets `close_date → { field, gte, lt }` on every row.
- **A windowed field that a bucket already bounds** narrows that bucket's entry to the part inside the window, and adds no entry of its own. Merging is by FIELD, not by dimension name: a drill filter keys by field, so a second entry on the same field (a `close_quarter` bucket over `close_date`, windowed through the `close_date` dimension) would have replaced the bucket's bound instead of meeting it.
- **The bounds are the query's own** (`drill-window.ts`, no second lowering): `lowerDatasetCompareDateRange`, this package's registered face in the shared `dateRange` conformance kit (a preset through `resolveAnalyticsDateRangeString` in the request's reference zone, an explicit `[a, b]` through `explicitDateRangeWindow`); the `{ $gte, $lt }` / `{ $gte, $lte }` pair both strategies build, through `normalizeDateRangeWindow` (the shared whole-day rule turns a bare-day `$lte` into `$lt` the next day); then core's `temporalStorageForm`, the rule the engine reads each temporal comparand through. `{token}` placeholders resolve with `resolveFilterTokens`, as the executor resolves them. The rule for which fields get an entry (`datetime` → instants, `date` → days, unknown type only under UTC) is the one the bucket ranges already used, now a shared `instantOf` in that block.
- **No entry when there is no exact half-open spelling:** an explicit window whose end is an instant (the query compares `<=` it) or the last supported day (no upper bound). The drill then stays as wide as before.
- **Spec wording only:** the `drillRanges` docblock on `AnalyticsResult` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/analytics-service.ts`) and its `.describe` text on the dataset answer schema (`packages/spec/src/api/analytics.zod.ts`) say what the key now carries; the generated `content/docs/references/api/analytics.mdx` row is regenerated. No key, type or export added.

### Why `drillRanges` carries it with no ui edit (seat lean, measured)

Every ui drill path hands the row's `drillRanges[i]` to `buildDatasetDrillFilter` (`ui/packages/core/src/utils/dataset-format.ts`), which iterates `Object.values(rawRanges)` and writes `{ [r.field]: { $gte: r.gte, $lt: r.lt } }` for each entry whatever its key: the report row drill and pivot cell drill (`DatasetReportRenderer.tsx`) and the dashboard widget (`DatasetWidget.tsx`, which also treats a non-empty `drillRanges` as drillable). The real-engine half of the new test runs exactly that filter shape against `engine.find` and lists what each row counted. So the reach closes with no ui change, and an existing reader sees only more entries in a key it already reads (`Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `patch`).

## Tests

`packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/dataset-drill-window.test.ts`, 21 cases, clock frozen at `2026-09-09T12:34:56.789Z`.

- **Unit, through `queryDataset` over a recorded engine aggregate (ObjectQL face):** stage × `this_quarter` on a `datetime` field in `Asia/Shanghai` answers `close_date → { gte: '2026-06-30T16:00:00.000Z', lt: '2026-09-30T16:00:00.000Z' }` on every row, and the test reads the very same `{ $gte, $lt }` off the filter the strategy handed the engine. Month buckets × `last_30_days` are narrowed at both edges with the middle untouched (Shanghai `datetime`, and an explicit `[2026-07-15, 2026-09-14]` on a `date` field). A window through `close_date` over a `close_quarter` bucket on the same field narrows that entry and adds none. An explicit bare-day window on `datetime` runs to the next UTC midnight; a `{month_start}`..`{today}` token window resolves as the executor resolves it; an instant end and a `9999-12-31` end get no entry.
- **Controls:** no `dateRange` (equality-only grouping answers no `drillRanges`; a granularity-only entry keeps its bucket range); a `date` field serialises calendar days; UTC resolves at UTC midnight; an unknown field type under a non-UTC zone gets no entry; `compareTo` computes `cnt__compare` as before and the row drills the primary window.
- **Real engine (SQLite through `AnalyticsServicePlugin`'s own composition, native and ObjectQL strategies):** ten deals either side of Q3's edges in Shanghai and UTC. For each row, the drill filter the ui builds (`{ field: { $gte, $lt } }` per entry, ANDed with the row's raw grouped value) is run through `engine.find`, and the ids it lists must number exactly what the row counted: stage × `this_quarter` on `datetime` (Shanghai), stage × an explicit bare-day window on `datetime` (Shanghai), month × `last_30_days` (Shanghai), stage × `this_quarter` on `date` (UTC), and stage × `this_quarter` on `date` (Shanghai, parity only; see Acceptance notes).

**Red first:** with `analytics-service.ts` restored to `origin/main` `6845035c` and `drill-window.ts` removed (tree only, restored after with `git diff HEAD` empty and the blob hash equal), the file reads 18 failed / 3 passed; the three that pass are the base-true controls (no `dateRange`, the no-spelling ends, the unknown type). Green at head: 21/21.

**Ablations** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restore proven against the HEAD blob each time; this package's tests import its `src`, so no build is in the path):
1. Delete `if (w.gte > r.gte) r.gte = w.gte;` (the window's lower edge stops narrowing a bucket): 4 red, the two month-edge unit cases and the month × `last_30_days` real-engine case on both strategies.
2. Spell every bound as `datetime` (`temporalStorageForm(v, 'datetime')`): 4 red, every `date`-field unit case. The real-engine `date` cases stay green under it, as expected: the engine reads an instant comparand on a `date` column through the same storage rule.

## Acceptance notes

- **A preset on a `date` field east of UTC filters the wrong days (finding, not changed here).** The query compares a `date` column with the preset's zone-midnight instants read as their leading UTC day, so `this_quarter` in `Asia/Shanghai` counts 2026-06-30 and drops 2026-09-30 (measured on SQLite, both strategies; west of UTC the leading day is the right one). The drill reports that same storage-form window, so the list still shows what the row counted, and the real-engine case pins parity only. Which days the query should count is reported to the seat as a separate defect.
- **No exact spelling, no entry:** an explicit window whose end is an instant (compared `<=`), or `9999-12-31` (no upper bound), leaves the drill as wide as it was. No measured producer sends either: the report chip sends a preset name or a `[from, to]` of bare days.
- **Explicit bare-day windows on `datetime` are cut at UTC midnight** (ADR-0053 D-D), so the drill reports `T00:00:00.000Z` bounds even under Shanghai. That is what the query filters by; whether the explicit arm should follow the reference zone is ADR-0053's recorded open seam, not this card.
- **Totals rows** carry no range companion (`drillRawTotals` has equality values only), as before; no ui path reads `drillRawTotals` today.
- **Midnight race:** the drill bounds resolve a preset with their own `new Date()`, as each strategy does for the query. A request straddling the reference zone's midnight could resolve the two a day apart.
- **Overlap:** #27109 (#26893, the empty time-bucket fill) landed while this was in flight; `origin/main` is merged in (clean) and every suite above re-ran on the merged head. Both in-window months of the month × `last_30_days` real-engine case hold a deal, so its rows are the same with or without that fill. #26739 (measure polarity, open) edits other hunks of `analytics-service.ts` and the two spec files.
